entities.name: Boris Barać
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Boris Barać is a Croatian professional basketball player for Falco KC Szombathely of the Hungarian first division. Standing at 2.06 m, he plays at the power forward position. His older brother Stanko Barać was also a professional basketball player. He grew up at HKK Široki, and signed a three-year contract with Zadar in 2014.
